trust_boundary.formal: Lean kernel, stable clean pinned Mathlib and standard foundational axioms only. Each proof source/environment/compiler/dependency receipt is checked. Mathematical models do not prove Rust/MIR or BigInt/serde implementations.
trust_boundary.runtime: Captured compiler/std, safe collection/storage contracts, canonical arbitrary-precision Q arithmetic/GCD and checked BasicMatrix. Standard serde/Clone/Eq derivations and caller-supplied serializer/AsRef contracts are explicitly delegated; arbitrary user trait code is not promised panic-free.
trust_boundary.scope: Local root crate pub mod homology and its actual native parent semantics. omega_homology is a separately resolved dependency; same-name external imports are not consumers of these local types. The complete renamed Carrier context preserves the nominal cycle and is independently reversed/checked; no surrogate providers or visibility widening.

assurance_limits: No A+, Rust/MIR extraction, complete compiler read trace, allocator-totality/crash-freedom, origin/authentication, hash injectivity or whole-workspace/application pass.

Native integer/field cases and designated faults are finite, scope-bound evidence. Kernel models establish their stated general mathematical/data invariants; representation correspondence is separately reviewed source evidence.
Contracts remain pending. No physical, publication, provenance-truth or authority promotion is inferred.

G1: SHA-256 binds current source, all explicit production bodies/data declarations, actual local caller contexts and independent native/proof receipts. Delivered behavior and authority ceiling are literal; domain titles and stored metadata do not raise capability.

Root lib.rs declares the local homology module. Cargo metadata resolves omega_homology to a separate source tree, so external GR/WDP imports are not misidentified as users of this local API. The historical simplicial external-caller attribution is explicitly withdrawn.
G4: Final 053739Z compiles and independently detects all 44 designated valid faults: scalar 9, witness 12, carrier 11, manifest 12. Every generated outcome is accounted for; none are equivalent/invalid/inconclusive/unrun in this final campaign.

The canonical local homology namespace passes 99 tests before/after, and all four positive controls pass before/after. Carrier control includes 99 native context tests plus two new independent fixtures. Its 11 mutant dispatches run their own independent Carrier fixtures, not other namespaces.

Initial 053100Z failed harness compilation on the copied Carrier/canonical-manifest nominal cycle and ran no faults. All 44 outcomes remain unrun there. Current 12 complete contexts reverse exactly to unchanged native peer text; 33 non-Carrier candidate byte strings match the initial copies and 11 renamed Carrier strings differ. This is disclosed source/custody repair, not silent invalid exclusion or an identical-byte claim for all candidates.

Distinct hash tags, unrelated dimensions/shapes, usize::MAX, Some/None and exact serde labels exercise every explicit field role and getter. Twelve metadata role/label/optional-field faults are detected, without pretending that mutable internal annotations constitute mathematical proofs.
G2: All six functions are exact typed field transport or tuple observation. No rational arithmetic, index conversion, clamp, dimension subtraction or implicit normalization occurs. ScalarAdmission.store_preserves is used only as the literal transport model, not as proof of any receipt annotation.

Independent distinct fields cover each constructor and serde label. Deliberately inconsistent HomologyWitness/CohomologyWitness data are retained in tests to demonstrate the actual unrestricted metadata domain; their type names do not establish the annotated dimension formula.
G3: Private unit fields block safe external literals for four receipt kinds; constructors are crate-visible trusted storage operations. Other fields are parent-visible, and no Deserialize path can manufacture a checked result from wire bytes. No mathematical seal beyond those access rules is claimed.

Canonical chain/cochain callers check shape, canonical coefficients and zero product before invoking the two law-receipt constructors. Remaining cycle/zero/result kinds have no production constructor calls in the current inventory and are not granted verification meaning. Standard derived clone/equality/serialization invokes captured runtime and caller serializer contracts.
G5: Six explicit production functions have CCN 1, cognitive 0 and nesting 0. Each stores a fixed number of owned digests, scalars and optional digests or copies a tuple; no recursion, collection allocation or hidden recomputation occurs. Derive execution and output serialization size are separately delegated, not measured as zero code.

formal_specification.domain: Owned Hash256 values, usize metadata, exact shape tuples, optional digest fields and nested record fields. No mathematical consistency invariant is enforced by these constructors.
formal_specification.delivered_behavior: Copy/move fields literally, retain a private unit marker on four receipt kinds, expose the two cochain shape getters, and derive cloning/equality/serialization of stored fields. No deserializer, independent checker or authenticated theorem status is provided.
formal_specification.failure: Constructors perform no arithmetic or fallible admission. Arbitrary inconsistent result annotations remain metadata; canonical chain/cochain producers must perform their own checks before storing their law receipts.

invariant_argument: The invariant is literal storage of typed input fields. Constructor bodies preserve each supplied field in its named slot, and getters return the matching tuple; the raw transport model says precisely that and no more. Standard derived Clone/Eq/Serialize follows the unchanged declarations.

Checked law status belongs to the audited producer call, not the record constructor/hash/name. Current chain/cochain callers check the corresponding product and populate these fields from the same admitted maps/dimensions. Unused record kinds are data-only with no independent certification claim.

failure_paths.construction: No fallible validation or mathematical operation; all typed payloads are stored. Absence of a checker is part of the advertised metadata scope, not mislabeled mathematical completion.
failure_paths.visibility: No safe external constructor/literal where private fields forbid it, and no Deserialize implementation. Internal producers retain their explicit preconditions; arbitrary caller serializer code follows its trait contract.
